sections.Profile:
The Criterium 75 pinball machine, released by Recel S. A. in April 1975, features a unique bicycle racing theme that simulates the excitement of criterium races. This electro-mechanical machine accommodates up to four players and includes two flippers, two pop bumpers, three captive balls, and a spinning target.

- Manufacturer: Recel S. A.
- Years made: 1975
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Racing, Sports, Original Theme, Bikes, 1970s
